_description: 违规处罚参考。用户验证数据替换训练记忆。

illegal_employment.rule: 雇主雇用无valid work pass的外国员工: first conviction: S$5,000-S$30,000 fine or up to 12 months imprisonment or both; subsequent: mandatory 1-12 months imprisonment + S$10,000-S$30,000 fine

false_declaration_work_pass.rule: 在任何work pass申请或renewal中作false statement: 最高S$20,000罚款或最长2年监禁或两者并处。适用于所有work pass类型。

fcf_debarment.rule: 违反FCF: work pass debarment minimum 12 months; more egregious cases up to 24 months。范围包括new applications和renewals。

salary_non_payment.rule: EA Part 3: first S$3,000-S$15,000 fine or up to 6 months imprisonment or both; subsequent higher

mrn.rule: First S$1,000 admin penalty; subsequent S$2,000. Failure to comply with direction: criminal, max S$5,000/6 months

pdpc_max.rule: PDPA: max 10% annual turnover or S$1M, whichever higher

tadm_claim_limits.individual: general: S$20,000 per claim; union: S$30,000 per claim
tadm_claim_limits.combined_salary_wrongful: non-union up to S$40,000 total; union up to S$60,000 total (subject to per claim limits)
